question.text: The number of ways in which the letters of the word 'VERTICAL' can be arranged without changing the order of the vowels is

solution.text:
Hint : Vowels 'EIA' to be kept in order, so out of 8 places 3 places can be chosen in \({ }^8 \mathrm{C}_3\) ways. Remaining 5 letters can be arranged in 5 ! ways.
\(\therefore\) Total number of ways \(={ }^8 \mathrm{C}_3 \times 5 !=\frac{8 !}{3 !}\)
